course_name_original: Makine Mühendisliğine Giriş ve Atölye Bilgisi
course_name_en: Introduction to Mechanical Engineering and Workshop Knowledge

learning_outcomes.text: Students taking this course should get to know the mechanical engineering profession and education.
Students should have the necessary preliminary knowledge to prepare themselves for business life.
Students should have knowledge about the duties and roles of engineers in general, and mechanical engineers in particular.
Students should have preliminary knowledge about working with machines and in a workshop.
Students should learn worker health and safety rules.
Students should have knowledge about professionalism and professional ethics.
Students should acquire basic knowledge about problem-solving and design processes.
Students should gain knowledge and skills in teamwork and group work.
Students should have knowledge about the working conditions of Mechanical Engineers and the basic problems they will face.
Students should develop a sense of professional ethics and responsibility.
Students should be able to evaluate the effects of technological developments related to the profession on social and economic life.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to KTUN Mechanical Engineering Department
Environmental problems and the engineer's responsibility
Introduction of internship and international student exchange programs
